notes.title: The Gamecat Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31340811/9cca8abba796830caaccc3f012bb722c7ac027be.jpg[/img]

Not only does Boxed In now offer continuous-movement and smooth-turning, it now has a tropical island that includes a pineapple riding a unicorn, a great white shark, a castle, and a jetpack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31340811/e9e28cdd8a26a76985a6849847bc70c6f32e12ab.jpg[/img]

The jetpack can be taken back into the main game where you can use it in all game modes, or you can stay on the island and enter a mini-game in the style of Sega's "Nights into Dreams".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31340811/3f5a99943e63470b9e6b2d6871c904dae7c8a032.jpg[/img]

How do you access this magical place? We'll leave that to you to figure out! (Or, you can just Google it.)

notes.title: Boxed In: The long-overdue update!
notes.content:
Ahead of the launch of Boxed In on PlayStation, we have updated the game with the following additions and improvements:

[list]
[*] [h3]Achievements[/h3]
There are now 51 Steam Achievements for you to unlock.

[*] [h3]Localisation[/h3]
You can play in English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Japanese or Italian.

[*] [h3]Support for more VR headsets[/h3]
The game detects Oculus Quest (1 and 2), Oculus Rift, Valve Index, HTC Vive and HTC Cosmos

[*] [h3]Controller Vibration[/h3]
Whether you're playing in VR or not, if your controller supports vibration...we rumble it!

[*] [h3]VR Seated Play Improvements[/h3]
You can now turn in the virtual world without turning in the real world.

[*] [h3]VR Comfort Options[/h3]
We added a "Blank screen when falling" option which is turned on by default.

[*] [h3]VR Depth Perception Improvements[/h3]
To make it easier to determine if blocks are aligned, we added a white border to the cubes.

[*] [h3]Audio Re-design[/h3]
When music was turned off, the game was eerily quiet. We have fixed that by adding suitable ambient sounds. In Survival mode, when music is on, we modify the music to add to the tension (it's subtle but it does the trick)!

[*] [h3]Optimised[/h3]
The game will run much faster on all machines.

[*] [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
If you were really, REALLY good at the game, it was possible to have the blocks moving so fast in Survival that the game crashed. Not any more!

[*] [h3]Some TLC (Tender Loving Care)[/h3]
We have polished the game into a much more enjoyable experience.
[/list]

Here's a video of the latest gameplay:
[previewyoutube=-lwvPp9oUh0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.content:
Greetings!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31340811/43c8ef15f7c085ed4445c652084ee810d2933856.jpg[/img]

We have just released v1.01 of Boxed In. This includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] Solitaire has a new soundtrack - more fitting of the game mode
[*] Added 'Game Over' and 'Game Complete' sound effects
[*] If try and change a cube's colour to the same colour - now play an error sound
[*] If try and add a block when not pointing at an existing block - play an error sound
[*] BUG FIX: Leaderboard now uses all available space to display scores
[*] BUG FIX: When playing "old school" (not in VR) made the player's collider thinner so can move between blocks
[*] BUG FIX: Fixed floor reflection not lining-up correctly (making blocks and the teleport ring look like they were floating)
[*] BUG FIX: In Solitaire mode - only score points for blocks that were NOT added by the player
[*] BUG FIX: 'Number of shots' no longer counts invalid shots (e.g. trying to fire red at red, etc.)
[*] BUG FIX: Teleporting is no longer blocked by the player's collision box
[/list]

If you discover any problems or you have any suggestions for future updates then head to the Discussions page and get in touch.

Happy gaming.

Red Chain Games ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Quick update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31340811/6303b151590a235c44b50cabc173a028618e1ee0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Seasons greetings![/h1]

Thanks for all the help from our beta testers. As a result of the feedback, we have just released an update with the following changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the FRIENDS leaderboard - it was still showing the GLOBAL leaderboard
[*] Improved the teleporter - when on top of blocks, the teleporter ignores the gaps between cubes making it more reliable to teleport especially when under pressure!

We are currently working on a TUTORIAL mode and hope to have it finished in time for release tomorrow! ːsteamhappyː

Red Chain Games
